topic: The meta agents that maintain an AI agent prompt library — a refusal-condition hook that checks only staged files has never run on the one prompt that fails it, and how prompt, skill, hook and AGENTS.md generator agents audit the library and keep it from drifting.

title.sub: A hook on staged files never audits the past.

stages.title: A rule for every prompt
stages.desc: Every prompt must state what it will not output, on a line starting Do not or Never.
stages.narration: Every prompt must say what it will not output. A hook checks.

stages.title: Run it over everything
stages.desc: The same check, once, over all 15 prompts, not only what is staged.
stages.narration: Run the same check once over all fifteen. Fourteen pass.

stages.title: Buried mid-sentence
stages.desc: Its only refusal is on line 18, in the middle of a list item.
stages.status: line 18: "Never anything that identifies a person."
stages.narration: Its only refusal is buried mid-sentence, where no hook or reader finds it.

stages.title: Never checked
stages.desc: The prompt and the hook arrived in the same commit. Staged-only means never run.
stages.narration: They arrived together, so the hook never ran on it.

stages.title: The smallest diff
stages.desc: The prompt agent lifts the refusal onto its own line. Meaning unchanged.
stages.status: Never include anything that identifies a person.
stages.narration: The prompt agent makes the smallest diff. One line, on its own.

stages.title: Rule to hook, or refuse
stages.desc: "Handle errors properly" cannot be checked. "No empty catch" can.
stages.status: hooks generator · under 2 seconds · two fixtures
stages.narration: The hooks agent scripts a rule, or calls it too vague.

stages.title: Shared rules, one place
stages.desc: A rule two agents need lives in AGENTS.md. Prompts cite it.
stages.narration: A rule two agents need moves into AGENTS dot md, before copies drift.

stages.title: A library that holds
stages.desc: Refusals on their own lines, hooks run once over everything, rules in one place.
stages.narration: Fifteen prompts, no duplicates, no dead paths. The library holds.

stages.title: Say what not to output
stages.desc: Fix with the smallest diff, turn rules into hooks, keep shared rules in AGENTS.md.
stages.status: AI agents that build AI agents
stages.narration: Say what not to output. On its own line.

end.title: Say what not to output.
end.sub: A hook on staged files never audits the past. Run it over everything once.

post.caption:
14 prompts pass. One was never checked. ✍️

A Flutter app keeps 15 AI agent prompts, and a pre-commit hook requires each one to state what it will NOT output, on a line starting "Do not" or "Never".

Run the same check once over the whole folder: 14 pass. One fails. Its only refusal is buried mid-sentence on line 18, and the hook arrived in the same commit as the prompt. A hook that checks staged files never audits the past.

Four meta agents keep a prompt library from drifting:
✍️ Prompt engineer: the smallest diff that fixes it.
🧩 Skill builder: rules from repeated review comments, not aspirations.
🪝 Hooks generator: a rule becomes a script, or it is too vague.
📄 AGENTS.md generator: a rule two agents need lives in one place.
